name: Thondroril River
summary: At Thondroril River, plague taints the waters between the Western and Eastern Plaguelands. It rises near Terrorweb Tunnel in Northern Lordaeron and flows south into Darrowmere Lake. Once a route for trade and travel through the fallen kingdom, its banks now shelter monstrous Scourge beasts and a legendary hermit.

sections.title: A River Cut by Ruin
sections.body:
Before Lordaeron fell, traffic followed Thondroril north toward the kingdom's holdings and south to Darrowmere Lake. Now the river marks a dangerous divide between the Western and Eastern Plaguelands.

Plague taints the water. Giant maggots, plaguebats, diseased bears, and predatory snapjaws infest the banks. Where a scenic riverbed once offered passage, travelers now face a deadly crossing.

sections.title: Watchers on the Bank
sections.body:
Tirion Fordring lives on the eastern bank in an overgrown homestead. The exiled Paladin lost his titles and went into hiding years ago.

From that refuge, the former lord watches the rotting river and the ruin of his homeland. He tests the mettle and conscience of adventurers who cross the blighted frontier.

faq.q: Where does the Thondroril River begin and end?
faq.answer: Thondroril River rises in Northern Lordaeron near the entrance to Terrorweb Tunnel. It flows south across the Plaguelands into Darrowmere Lake, then continues south beyond the lake as the Darrowmere River.

faq.q: What dangerous creatures live along the riverbanks?
faq.answer: Giant maggots, diseased bears, plaguebats, crypt spiders, and river snapjaws stalk the banks. Plague has turned native wildlife into lethal creatures.

faq.q: Who is the old man living by the eastern shore?
faq.answer: Tirion Fordring lives in a dilapidated farmhouse on the eastern bank. He was one of the original Knights of the Silver Hand, and the Alliance exiled him years before the Third War. Now he lives in seclusion, watching the Scourge.

faq.q: Why does the river divide the two Plaguelands?
faq.answer: Thondroril River forms a wide natural gorge through central Lordaeron. After the Scourge brought down the kingdom, cartographers and survivors came to treat the river as the frontier between the Western and Eastern Plaguelands.

angles.text: As a Paladin, you can find Tirion Fordring on the river's eastern shore. He helped found the Silver Hand, and his legacy endures despite his exile.
Along the damp, rotting riverbed, you can find hardy plague-tainted plants such as Sungrass, Arthas' Tears, and Plaguebloom near the murky shores.
